The [[RPAL Party|'''RPAL Party''']] officially [[RPAL Party|The Republican National Aretoix Lie Party]] ([[Arten]]: ''[[RPAL Party|Resivuoirno Pamanitnoix Areoix Lie]]''  or '''[[RPAL Party|RPAL]]''') Is a political party in [[Areoix Lie]] . It originated as a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liberation_movement liberation movement] founded in 1696 known for its opposition to [[3rd Empire of Areoix Lie|Imperial Rule]] and governed the country from 1716-1740, when [[1720 Areoix Lie general election|the first]] [[1720 Areoix Lie general election|Imperial Election]] resulted in [[Orin Valorion]] being elected as [[President of Areoix Lie|President of]] [[President of Areoix Lie|Areoix Lie]].
